sources.title: Broncos sign veteran safety Taylor Rapp to their practice squad
sources.description: According to multiple reports, including 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos are signing, or re-signing, veteran safety Taylor Rapp to their practice squad. The Broncos did sign 17-players to their practice squad last week, so they will need to make a corresponding move to make room for Rapp on their roster. Rapp originally signed […]
